dict.string: Home Triage Tricorder uses the camera locally on your device to record optical pulse waveforms (rPPG) and visual colorimetry for your personal wellness baseline and pre-visit clinician handoff summary. No video or images ever leave your device.

Home Triage Tricorder uses the microphone locally on your device to analyze acoustic waveform stability ("Ahhh" vocal biomarkers and ambient acoustic spectrograms) for your personal baseline and pre-visit clinician handoff report. No audio recordings are uploaded to any server.

Home Triage Tricorder uses the device accelerometer and gyroscope locally to measure outstretched-hand stability (4-12 Hz motion spectrum) and standing Romberg balance sway for your personal baseline and pre-visit clinician handoff summary.
